prep_meta.notes: 1) The raw datasets pr_rad/pr_rads/pricnr/pricnrs/srgprc/srgprcs are referenced in the variable intent but their full column lists are not shown in the provided sample data — only ad and ae samples were provided. Column names used for PRTRT (PRRADTYP, PRTYPOTS, SRGTERM, SRGTYP, TYPOTHSP, CMTRT), dates (PRRADDAT, SRGDAT, CMSTDAT), and reason variables (SRGRSN, CMRSN, PRRSN, SRGRSNSP, CMRSNSP, PRRSNSP, SRGPRSN, CMPRSN, PRPRSN) are inferred from Gilead naming conventions and the variable intent mapping rules — the programmer MUST verify these against the actual raw dataset column lists before running. 2) PRSTDY is a derived study day (integer) computed as (PRSTDTC - RFSTDTC)+1 for dates on/after RFSTDTC; the derive step above marks it for post-processing since arithmetic on ISO dates requires a compute step outside the declarative derive op. 3) PRSEQ must be re-derived as a sequential integer 1..n within USUBJID after sorting by USUBJID, PRSTDTC, PRTRT — the derive step sets a placeholder; the mapping program must implement the BY-group counter. 4) VISIT/VISITNUM are sourced from sdtm.sv via left-merge on USUBJID+VISIT; if the raw forms carry their own FOLDERSEQ as VISITNUM that value is used directly. 5) The *s suffix forms (pr_rads, pricnrs, srgprcs) are the status/summary companion forms and are the primary source for stop/pause reason variables (PRSREAS, PRSREASO, PRPREAS, PRPREASO, PRTRDISR).
